parent_objective: design a bounded sampling-compatible repair route for M2350 candidate packs after M2353 reset failures
blocked_by: M2353 reset validation failed 32 of 360 reset attempts
M2354 localizes most failures to G/GH timing transforms
supersedes: direct measured execution after failed candidate-pack reset validation

public_gates: M2355 must design a no-reset sampling-compatible repair route for the candidate packs
M2355 must address the 32 M2353 reset failures and especially the late_close to mid timing transform failures
M2355 must preserve five-pack discipline and metadata caveat reporting
M2355 must not run reset rollout measured execution training replay PPO private holdout ranking or paper/self-ID claims
forbidden_shortcuts: do not rank support policies or controller families
do not overwrite the active scenario config
do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion
do not claim scenario redesign executed
do not claim reset-valid redesigned scenario pack

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs a bounded no-reset repair route for sampler-incompatible candidate transforms
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no reset rerun, rollout, ranking, paper, finite-window-vs-GRU, or self-ID claim
stop_condition: stop if design cannot address the 32 M2353 failures
stop if design expands into raw candidate search
stop if design reruns reset or routes directly to measured execution
stop if design claims reset-valid pack
fallback_plan: route to artifact-only repaired materializer implementation if bounded rules are sufficient
pivot to failure-source mapping implementation if repair rules are underdetermined
stop for user review if no bounded repair route is supported
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M2354 routes M2353 reset failure to sampling-compatible candidate pack repair design

admission_evidence: M2354 classifies M2353 failure as sampling_incompatible_candidate_transform
27 of 32 failures include late_close to mid timing transforms
baseline pack resets 72/72 and metadata caveats are preserved
allowed_updates: M2355 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest selected by the design
next_stage_criteria: failure rows and transform classes are addressed
a no-ranking follow-up route is selected

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2355 designs task-quality repair and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: None in M2355; no wrong-history reset-hidden zero-history finite-window or GRU comparison is run.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: Candidate-pack repair design must not be interpreted as driver, controller, or self-ID evidence.
allowed_claims: no reset-valid pack, controller ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU result, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: turns a classified reset failure into bounded repair design rather than rerunning the same gate
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can prepare repaired candidate packs for another reset-validity attempt, but cannot establish driver performance
must_synthesize_if: M2355 routes to direct measured execution
the sampling repair branch reaches 10 milestones without synthesis

hypothesis: A bounded no-reset repair design can make the M2350 dual-axis candidate pack route sampling-compatible without expanding back into raw candidate search.
success_criteria: the 32 M2353 failures are addressed by transform class
a follow-up non-ranking route is selected
failure_criteria: M2355 runs reset rollout measured execution replay PPO or private holdout
M2355 ranks support policies or controller families
M2355 makes paper-level finite-window-vs-GRU or level3 self-ID claims
M2355 claims scenario redesign executed or reset-valid redesigned scenario pack
M2355 routes directly to controller comparison

commands.name: design
commands.command: manual design from M2354 audit and M2350/M2353 artifacts

decision_rule: M2355 passes if it designs a bounded non-ranking repair route that addresses the M2353 reset failures without rerun or execution claims.
